raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.isReserved = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) AS collector_premium
FROM main.cards c
JOIN main.sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-02-01' 
  AND s.releaseDate < '2017-03-01'
```
